integrity: The complete proof and reproduction checker are included. Numerical values are supplemental to an analytic all-parameter proof. Prior-art comparisons were made with materially inspected literature; independent expert validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional Euclidean right circular solid cones only. The thresholds are unique zeros of explicit transcendental functions rather than elementary constants; no claims for oblique or truncated cones. Published 2009 cone paper has no verified exact public day; the dated public 2011 arXiv v1 is the exact-date anchor. The directly relevant Wills preprint is recorded publicly as 09/2012, but its day is not verified, and it is not confused with the later 2013 journal issue.
title: Exact two-transition real-root window for Wills polynomials of right circular cones
